description: Completeness is derived strictly by auditing required rule family coverage rows against verified source evidence. Caller booleans are completely ignored.

derivationRules.callerSelfCertificationDisregarded: Any caller supplied isComplete: true or rulebookCompleteness: { isComplete: true } is stripped and replaced by pure derived boolean.
derivationRules.familyExhaustiveRule: A family is VERIFIED_COMPLETE only if coverageStatus === EXHAUSTIVE and evidenceRefs.length > 0.
derivationRules.absenceAttestationRule: A family is NOT_APPLICABLE_VERIFIED only if backed by an explicit verified AbsenceAttestation with reviewStatus === AUDITED_ABSENCE_CONFIRMED.
derivationRules.unresolvedFallbackRule: Missing coverage row, partial coverage, unverified absence, or empty evidenceRefs forces family status to UNRESOLVED.
derivationRules.packageCompletenessRule: isComplete is true IF AND ONLY IF all mandatory families are either VERIFIED_COMPLETE or NOT_APPLICABLE_VERIFIED.
